findings.summary: Host prompts disclose the expected dispositions, receipt fields and action sequence
findings.diagnosis: The default prompt dictates the report-only Nit record, disposition preconditions and escalation and refusal fields; the receipt prompt (line 230) dictates pending state instead of ci; the fix-effort prompt (line 102) scripts review, repair, check and re-review. The verifier asserts these same outcomes, against the plan's requirement to keep expected outcomes outside host input.
findings.reason: Rows 21, 22, 25, 26 and 31 cannot attribute the observed behavior to the distributed procedure. Remove outcome instructions, keep only tool mechanics, and rerun the affected cases.

findings.summary: Refused tracker create attempts are ignored by zero-write checks
findings.diagnosis: A ValueError from tracker_args on a refused call without an exact --db or --config token is skipped, so a create with an unsupported option or --db=value never enters creates or writes.
findings.reason: Row 26 requires zero create invocations and the plan counts refused calls; wrong-feature and pending cases can pass despite an attempt. Count them and add a negative control.

findings.summary: Required overlap-only negative control is absent
findings.diagnosis: Row 18 requires retaining the overlap-only negative control and row 2 an overlap variation. The r26 README says it was not run, r25 QA lists it absent, and the preparer has no variant that stages it.
findings.reason: An approved acceptance obligation is unmet; without it the paired Fix runs do not show that changed-line overlap affects the decision.

findings.summary: Fix ordering check accepts a disposition recorded before verification
findings.diagnosis: The condition only requires edit before disposition and no verify before edit, so edit, disposition, verify passes.
findings.reason: The check cannot fail on the property its message names; require the passing verify before the disposition and test it.

findings.summary: Pair prompt comparison uses regenerated prompts, not delivered ones
findings.diagnosis: normalized_prompt calls host.prompt on both cases at verification time, so equality follows from file presence and ignores what each host received.
findings.reason: Compare run-bound prompts from host.jsonl against the pinned binding digests.

findings.summary: Row 18 pair never requires the large unrelated diff
findings.diagnosis: An empty preserved map passes, and only differing commits are checked; swapping the roots skips preservation in fix_pair.
findings.reason: Require that exactly the second case carries the unrelated file and that it is the only candidate difference.

findings.summary: effort_pair reports observed without observing either run
findings.diagnosis: Only four input files are compared; run status, delivered prompts and candidate bytes are ignored. The existing test obtains observed for a pair containing a stale-identity run.
findings.reason: Require both cases to verify and compare delivered prompts and candidates.

findings.summary: fix_pair has no negative controls for its comparisons
findings.diagnosis: The only test covers an unobserved pair and asserts that structural mismatches are absent; no input is mutated to show a check fires.
findings.reason: Mutate grant, prompt, finding, commit, resulting text and unrelated file individually.

findings.summary: --only verification skips delivered prompt, grant and runner binding
findings.diagnosis: matching_dispatch is not run for --only cases, including rows 18 and 22.
findings.reason: An altered invocation could verify; retained r26 hashes were checked and match.

findings.summary: Distribution test neither protects the triage procedure nor the parent handoff
findings.diagnosis: Triage SKILL.md is not in the path list, and the word parent already existed at the base in the review-code workflow and both deep-review files.
findings.reason: Assert the procedure heading and its key obligations in triage SKILL.md and a specific handoff phrase in callers.

findings.summary: Attended-only directives are not scoped around the unattended branch
findings.diagnosis: Step 0's immediate fix, Step 5's confirmation requirement, the matching anti-pattern and the frontmatter conflict with the unattended authority checks and authorized creation.
findings.reason: A host could edit without authority or refuse an authorized create; state the precedence explicitly.

findings.summary: Real host credentials are readable by the agent under test
findings.diagnosis: Credentials are copied into the case HOME while a Bash-enabled agent runs without a filesystem sandbox, and its trace is retained in the repository.
findings.reason: No leaked token was found by pattern scan; hardening the isolation can be tracked separately.

findings.diagnosis: A file named only .txt sits beside the five named traces.
findings.reason: Remove it or explain it; check the retained checksum list when doing so.
